projects.title: Temperature Time Series Course Project
bullets: Identified missing observations in public temperature sensor time series as part of a supervised undergraduate course project on environmental forecasting.
Implemented a seasonal forecasting baseline for public temperature sensor series in the course project, working with Python, pandas, and scikit-learn.

research.title: Rainfall Time Series Research Assistance
bullets: Aligned public rainfall measurement time series and identified missing observations while assisting with supervised faculty research on environmental forecasting.
Plotted forecast residuals for the public rainfall series as a student research assistant, working with Python, pandas, and scikit-learn.
